description: Canary deploy a new version of a production web service with progressive traffic ramp from 5% to 50% to 100% using Istio VirtualService. Monitor 5xx error rates continuously; auto-rollback immediately if error rate exceeds 1% over a 2-minute sliding window. Health check gates must pass at each step before proceeding to the next traffic level. The service must never serve more than 50% traffic to the canary if readiness or health probes fail on the new version.
